violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED SALMON AT 130-134F AND COOKED SHIRMP WITH VEGETABLES AT 124-126F IN THE 1-DOOR HOTBOX.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED FOODS TO 165F DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THAT HOT HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT A MINIMUM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and is in poor repair: OBSERVED THE 1-DOOR HOTBOX AT THE HIGHEST LEVEL SETTING AND MAINTAINING TEMPERATURE ONLY AT 140F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC UNDERSTANDS HOT- HOLDING UNITS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED AT 165F OR ABOVE TO ENSURE HOT HOLDING FOODS ARE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE. PLEASE ENSURE THIS UNIT IS REPAIRED/ADJUSTED/REPLACED PRIOR TO USING FOR HOT HOLDING FOODS AGAIN.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED WATER SPRAYING PRIOR TO ENTERING FLOOR DRAIN COMING FROM PIPING AT THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE INSTALL A FUNNEL AROUND BOTH FLOOR DRAINS TO PREVENT WATER FROM SPRAYING ON THE FLOOR AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at THREE OUT OF THE FOUR handwashing sinks IN THE MAIN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REQUESTED MAINTENANCE TO ADD PAPER TOWELS TO DISPENSERS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS. PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED HAM AT 64F, SLICED TURKEY AT 61F, CUT LETTUCE AT 51F, SLICED TOMATOES AT 50-53F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 47F, SLICED CHEESE AT 48F, SLICED CHEESE #2 AT 50F, AND SLICED TURKEY #2 AT 56F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOODS TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41 OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES AND THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 1-DOOR LOWBOY PREP-TOP AT 58F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED/MOVED FOODS IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FOODS ON STEAM TABLE: BAKED POTATOES AT 44F, HOT DOGS AT 121F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F BEFORE RETURNING TO THE STEAM TABLE.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED FROZEN ROP SALMON THAWING IN PREP SINK UNDER RUNNING WATER.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE SALMON FROM PACKAGING AND RETURN TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR TO CONTINUE THAWING PROCESS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system AT THE MOP SINK FAUCET CONNECTED TO THE CHEMICAL SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE FORWARD EVIDENCE OF PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION TO EHS WITHIN 3 DAYS.
